title: 第5章 名扬清风城第6章 万家万尘
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 秦叶并没有现在就打开盲盒，还是等回去再打开，并不急于一时。
“虎拳门也不过如此。”武萱儿举了举小拳头，讥讽道。只是这个样子，怎么看怎么都觉得可爱。
清风宗与虎拳门本来就有宿怨，再加上今日虎拳门上门来找麻烦，武萱儿自然不会客气。
虎拳门众弟子脸色顿时黑了下来，但是又不敢反驳，连外门长老都不是他们的对手，更不要说他们了。
秦叶在打他们虎拳门的脸，但是他们却是连反驳都不敢，别提有多憋屈。
城主府。
城主周大海听着下面人的汇报，微微皱眉，说道：“这秦叶前几日我见过，除了一副好看的皮囊，并没有出色的表现。没想到重伤之后，竟然变厉害了，难道有什么奇遇？”
“城主，会不会是他们在演戏？”汇报情报的那个执事疑惑道。
“不可能，清风宗与虎拳门数年间因为资源问题争斗不断，互有死伤，这次清风宗回去途中遇袭，我就怀疑是虎拳门的手段，只是没有证据。”
“再说，即使有证据又如何，宗门不归朝廷管辖，宗门之间恩怨，由他们自己解决，只要不涉及到清风城的安危即可。”
周大海站起身来，缓缓说道。
宗门与王朝的关系有点微妙，那些大宗门根本不将王朝放在眼里，而那些小宗门又大多数依附在大宗门门下，所以基本上王朝即使想管也管不了。
“继续关注这个秦叶，此人或许不会那么简单，如果他有需求，只要不过分的话，就给予他方便。”周大海吩咐道。
“是！城主。”那执事应声道。
“我虎拳门还无需你一个小女娃子来评价。”随着话音落下，两个中年男子走了出来，身后跟着一群弟子，其中一名中年男子满脸煞气的看着秦叶。
“掌门！”
那刘长老与众弟子立刻恭声行礼道。
众人皆是一惊，竟然是虎拳门掌门到了，这可是难得一见啊。在这清风城真正有权势的大人物，除了城主，就是几大门派的掌门了。
他浑身气势压向秦叶与武萱儿，秦叶将武萱儿拉到身后，自己却是纹身不动。
“还算有点本事，怪不得能打伤我外门长老。”
中年男子见自己气势压迫未能伤到秦叶，惊疑了一声。
“虎拳门掌门竟然来了，这下有好戏看了。”
“周掌门可是半只脚踏入先天的人，这小子这下子死定了。”
“听说周掌门曾经与一只妖兽战斗了上千招，虽然最后不敌，但是能与妖兽战斗上千招，已经非常恐怖了，这实力恐怕已经媲美先天了。”
“有周掌门在，这清风宗今天恐怕要被除名了。”
此时，围观的众人也是越来越多，有其他宗门弟子执事，也有清风城各大家族，他们即使没有与虎拳门打过交道，但是也有不少人见过他。
“你们看，周掌门身边那人不是铁剑宗掌门郑戊阳吗？”
有人眼尖，一眼认出了另一个中年男子的身份。
顿时又引起一阵哗然，虎拳门掌门竟然与铁剑宗掌门走在一起，难道是这两个门派结盟了吗？
“郑兄，那件事情稍后再谈，就先让我收拾了这两个小辈。”周掌门朝着郑戊阳说道。
content_en:
Qin Ye did not open the blind box now, but waited until he got back to open it, not in a hurry.
"The Tiger Fist Sect is nothing more than that." Wu Xuan'er raised her fist and said sarcastically. It's just like this, no matter how you look at it, you'll find it cute.
The Qingfeng Sect and the Tiger Fist Sect already had an old grudge, and with the Tiger Fist Sect coming to look for trouble today, Wu Xuan'er would naturally not be polite.
The faces of the disciples of the Tiger Fist Sect suddenly darkened, but they did not dare to refute. Even the elders of the outer sect were no match for them, let alone them.
Qin Ye was slapping their Tiger Fist Sect in the face, but they didn't even dare to refute, not to mention how aggrieved they were.
City Lord's Mansion.
City Lord Zhou Dahai listened to the report of the people below, frowned slightly, and said: "I saw this Qin Ye a few days ago. Apart from a good-looking skin, he didn't have any outstanding performance. I didn't expect that after being seriously injured, he actually became stronger. Is there any adventure?"
"City Lord, are they acting?" the deacon who reported the information asked doubtfully.
"It's impossible. The Qingfeng Sect and the Tiger Fist Sect have been fighting for several years due to resource issues, causing casualties to each other. This time the Qingfeng Sect was attacked on the way back, so I suspected that it was the Tiger Fist Sect's method, but there is no evidence."
"Besides, so what if there is evidence, the sects are not under the jurisdiction of the imperial court, and the grievances between the sects are left to be resolved by themselves, as long as the safety of Qingfeng City is not involved."
Zhou Dahai stood up and said slowly.
The relationship between sects and dynasties is a bit delicate. The big sects don't pay attention to the dynasty at all, and most of the small sects are attached to the big sects, so basically the dynasty can't control it even if it wants to.
"Continue to pay attention to this Qin Ye. This person may not be that simple. If he has needs, as long as it is not excessive, we will provide him with convenience." Zhou Dahai ordered.
"Yes! City Lord." The deacon responded.
…
"Our Tiger Fist Sect doesn't need a little girl like you to judge us." As the words fell, two middle-aged men walked out, followed by a group of disciples. One of the middle-aged men looked at Qin Ye with an evil look on his face.
"Head!"
Elder Liu and his disciples immediately saluted respectfully.
Everyone was shocked to see that the leader of the Tiger Fist Sect had arrived. This was a rare sight. The truly powerful people in Qingfeng City, apart from the city lord, are the heads of several major sects.
He pressed towards Qin Ye and Wu Xuan'er with all his momentum. Qin Ye pulled Wu Xuan'er behind him, but his tattoo did not move.
"You're quite capable, no wonder you were able to injure my outer elder."
The middle-aged man was surprised when he saw that his overwhelming momentum failed to hurt Qin Ye.
"The leader of the Tiger Fist Sect is actually here. Now we have something good to watch."
"Headmaster Zhou is a man with half a foot in the innate world. This kid is dead now."
"I heard that Master Zhou once fought a monster with thousands of moves. Although he was defeated in the end, being able to fight with a monster with thousands of moves is already very terrifying. This strength is probably comparable to the innate."
"With Head Zhou here, I'm afraid the Qingfeng Sect will be expelled today."
At this time, more and more people were watching, including other sect disciples, deacons, and major families in Qingfeng City. Even though they had not dealt with the Tiger Fist Sect, many people had seen him.
"Look, isn't the person next to Head Zhou Zheng Wuyang, the head of the Iron Sword Sect?"
Someone had sharp eyes and recognized the identity of another middle-aged man at a glance.
Suddenly there was another uproar. The leader of the Tiger Fist Sect actually walked together with the leader of the Iron Sword Sect. Could it be that these two sects had formed an alliance?
"Brother Zheng, we will discuss that matter later. Let me take care of these two juniors first." Head Zhou said to Zheng Wuyang.
